evidence: Built the criterion->requirement map for every criterion in gates (2), functional, polish (5) and visual (5). Each graded demand traces to instruction.md or hireops_rules.md: job fields, places whole 1-50, HM-only manager (rules lines 27-29) -> hro_job_open; email validity, case-insensitive per-job duplicate, refusal at the field keeping typed text (31-35) -> hro_add_email_rules; bottom of Applied (32) -> hro_add_candidate; one-stage moves, non-blank reject reason, no reject from Hired, reopen only to rejected-from stage with reason cleared, non-drag controls (47-53) -> move/reject/reopen rows; manual shared order and arrival at bottom (57-59) -> hro_arrive_bottom/hro_reorder; Interview capacity, reorder inside full Interview, freed place (63-65) -> interview rows; manager late-stage permissions (70-72) -> hro_mgr_*; 409 plus who changed it (77-80; instruction line 3) -> hro_stale_refused; optimistic put-back with reason and focus on that card's controls (84-85) -> hro_refused_put_back; bulk all-or-none in board order with places counted for the set (89-92) -> hro_bulk_*; undo semantics incl. reason restore, conflict, once-only, later move supersedes, overfill refusal, note not a change (96-100) -> hro_undo_*/hro_reopen; activity incl. re-orderings and undos, newest first, per-job filter, no line for refusals (110-113) -> hro_activity*; 401/403/404 (21-23) -> hro_anonymous/hro_refusal_status/hro_thread_access; live 15 s updates preserving typing/focus/open card/scroll (117-123) -> hro_live_board, hro_pol_live_*; Enter/Shift+Enter/empty focused box/failed send kept (138-140) -> hro_msg_compose/hro_pol_failed_send; 30-message paging with remaining count and anchored place (144-147) -> hro_thread_*/hro_pol_earlier_place; per-person unread and total, scrolled-up notice (151-160) -> hro_unread_*; seen rules, observer never counts (164-166) -> hro_seen; reply drafts per person/conversation/browser, re-sign-in prompt, other users see none (170-175) and note drafts 'kept for that person on that browser' (106) -> hro_drafts/hro_pol_session_resume; candidate wording and privacy (179-194) -> hro_candidate_*; restart persistence without reseeding (instruction line 15; integration lines 8-10) -> hro_restart. Seed facts used by criteria match seed_data.json: Lena read_count 2 of 3 messages, last by USR-REC3 -> 1 unread (hro_unread_counts); Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco and Screen Priya/Samuel by position; Noor note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (hro_restart, protocol Z). No criterion demands an exact label, route, selector, field name, layout or wording: functional prompt line 15 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'; app_context lines 33-34; hiding refused actions is optional (prompt line 23; hro_move_one_stage, hro_reject_hired, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_observer_readonly, hro_undo_once). Display demands are conditional or lenient (job details 'wherever the app shows job details or are evidenced by behaviour'; rejected-from stage 'on the card, its details, its reopen control or its Activity line'; stale-refusal identity 'by name ... or by an identifier that the app's own staff data shows'). The render gate's sign-in check is the workbook-internal and skill known false positive, and sign-in is public anyway (instruction line 17). Visual rows are generic Likert craft; visual prompt line 14 leaves layout, labels and styles to the implementer and excludes phone layout and theming. Note-level instances reported (not defects): (N1) hro_add_candidate (functional/judge.toml line 38) requires the email and the entered source 'wherever the app shows card details'; rules line 104 only says a card opens 'to show its details', so showing source rests on the professional default that an application's details include the data entered for it; the golden shows both (board.js line 130). An app whose details pane omits source would lose this 0.5-weight row. (N2) hro_refused_put_back (line 137) requires a shown reason; an app that hides the Interview target when Interview is full (prompt line 23 calls offering a refused action 'the app's choice') shows no refusal and could score 0 unless the judge accepts a capacity indicator as the reason. The demand follows public text (instruction line 3 'tell me why'; rules 84-85) and the criterion already accepts a UI pre-refusal with reason and focus, so it is not an unrequired demand, but the wording tension could cost a defensible app. The golden offers the attempt and refocuses the card (board.js lines 170, 203, 338). (N3) Protocol B(12) lets Mei re-order Y 'within its stage' in Screen where A2 sits at the bottom; moving Y past A2 shifts A2's index, and an app treating that as A2 being re-ordered would refuse the undo the criterion expects to succeed; rules line 98 refers to the undone cards themselves being re-ordered, so the expectation is supported, but 'one place' would remove the ambiguity. Risk=true only because no full configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'); absence of a false-fail on the golden or a conforming alternative is source-reasoned and supported by scripted observations, not measured.
